Sources: Shalimar Corp website, UP RERA project records (via Aurum PropTech's RERA mirror), Realty Today, ThePrint/ANI and project listings where marked. Independent guide by DSD Properties — we are not affiliated with Shalimar Corp. Updated: 18 October 2026.

Key Facts (updated 18 October 2026)

  • Shalimar Corp Limited is a Lucknow real estate developer established in 1988, headquartered at Shalimar Titanium, Vibhuti Khand, Gomti Nagar (Shalimar Corp website).
  • On 1 October 2026, HDFC Capital and Shalimar Corp announced a ₹750 crore platform for housing in Lucknow, Varanasi and Kanpur — over 5 million sq ft and about 3,000 homes (Realty Today, 1 Oct 2026).
  • Its largest Lucknow development, Shalimar OneWorld in Gomti Nagar Extension, is registered with UP RERA phase by phase, and some phases are registered by a group company, not Shalimar Corp itself (RERA record).
  • Shalimar Gallant West (UPRERAPRJ569037, 69 flats) has a RERA completion date of 20 October 2026; Shalimar Sky Garden (UPRERAPRJ160941) is due on 25 October 2028 (RERA record, RERA record).
  • Shalimar Mannat and Paradise, marketed on Faizabad Road, are registered with RERA in Barabanki district (RERA record, RERA record).

Shalimar is one of the most visible developer names in Lucknow — on Gomti Nagar Extension, in Mahanagar, on Faizabad Road and in Vibhuti Khand. This guide sets out what can be checked about the company and its projects from official records: who the company is, which projects are registered with UP RERA, their registration and completion dates, and what a buyer should verify before paying a booking amount. Where a figure comes only from a property listing, we say so.

Latest news

  • 1 October 2026: HDFC Capital Advisors and Shalimar Corp created a ₹750 crore platform for residential and mixed-use projects in Lucknow, Varanasi and Kanpur, with over 5 million sq ft of development potential and about 3,000 homes. HDFC Capital MD & CEO Vipul Roongta said emerging urban centres in Uttar Pradesh "are set to lead the next phase of housing growth" (Realty Today, 1 Oct 2026).

Shalimar OneWorld, Gomti Nagar Extension — how it is set up

Shalimar OneWorld is an integrated township at Village Baghamau, Gomti Nagar Extension, near Amar Shaheed Path (Realty Doctors). It is not one RERA project: each phase — such as Valencia County, Marbella, Pinnacle, Twenty One, Whispering Woods, Belvedere Suites and Belvedere Court, all listed on the Shalimar Corp website — is registered separately.

Two points matter for buyers. First, published figures for the township's total size differ (about 200, 212 and 225 acres have all appeared), so ask for the approved layout of your phase rather than relying on a headline number (Realty Doctors). Second, the RERA promoter can be a group company: Whispering Woods (GH-14) is registered by M/s Shalimar Lakecity Private Limited, formerly M/s ANS Developers Private Limited (RERA record). Your builder–buyer agreement should name the same company as the RERA record of your phase.

For the area itself, see our Gomti Nagar Extension guide.

Gallant West — completion date is now

Gallant West's RERA completion date is 20 October 2026, and the record still shows construction in progress (RERA record). If you have booked or are about to, check on up-rera.in whether the promoter has applied for an extension, and read the latest quarterly progress report. Under the RERA Act, a buyer is entitled to interest for delay beyond the agreed date, or a refund with interest.

Whispering Woods — completion date has passed

The RERA completion date for Whispering Woods (GH-14) was 30 September 2026 (RERA record). Check the live record for an extension or a completion/occupancy certificate before paying further instalments or buying on resale.

Why some "Lucknow" projects are registered in Barabanki

Mannat and Paradise are marketed on Faizabad Road, Lucknow, but their land is in Nawabganj tehsil of Barabanki district, and RERA lists them there. In practice this means the sale deed is registered at the Barabanki sub-registrar office and Barabanki's circle rates apply. Make sure your documents and stamp duty calculation use the correct district.

Buying a Shalimar flat or plot? Check these first

  1. RERA number of your exact phase — a township can have many. Search it on up-rera.in.
  2. Promoter name — it must match the company in your builder–buyer agreement and on the payment receipts.
  3. Completion date and extensions — compare the RERA date with the possession date in your agreement.
  4. Quarterly progress report — RERA promoters file construction progress; read the latest one for your tower.
  5. Carpet area — the agreement should state carpet area as per RERA, not only super area.
  6. For resale in a completed project — ask for the completion/occupancy certificate, the seller's registered sale deed, maintenance dues clearance, and an encumbrance certificate; check past registries on IGRSUP.
  7. District — for Faizabad Road projects, confirm whether the land is in Lucknow or Barabanki.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

When was Shalimar Corp founded and who runs it?

Shalimar Corp Limited was established in 1988 and is headquartered at Shalimar Titanium, Vibhuti Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow (Shalimar Corp website). Khalid Masood is its Managing Director (Realty Today, 1 Oct 2026) and Kunal Seth is a Director (ThePrint / ANI, 14 Jul 2026).

Where is Shalimar OneWorld?

Shalimar OneWorld is an integrated township at Village Baghamau, Gomti Nagar Extension, near Amar Shaheed Path (Realty Doctors). It is registered with UP RERA phase by phase, so each tower or block has its own RERA number.

Is Shalimar Mannat in Lucknow or Barabanki?

Shalimar Mannat is marketed on Faizabad Road, Lucknow, but UP RERA lists Mannat Phase-1 (UPRERAPRJ8345) in Barabanki district, Nawabganj tehsil (RERA record). Property is registered at the sub-registrar office of the district where it lies.

Is Shalimar Gallant West RERA registered?

Yes. Shalimar Gallant West is registered as UPRERAPRJ569037, approved on 20 October 2022, with 69 apartments and a completion date of 20 October 2026 in the RERA record (RERA record). Check up-rera.in for any extension before you book.

How do I check the RERA status of a Shalimar project?

Go to up-rera.in, search the project by its RERA number, and check four things: the promoter name, the completion date and any extension, the latest quarterly progress report, and the carpet area of your unit type. All four must match your agreement.

Who is the promoter of Shalimar OneWorld phases on RERA?

It varies by phase. For example, Whispering Woods (GH-14) is registered by M/s Shalimar Lakecity Private Limited (formerly M/s ANS Developers Private Limited) as UPRERAPRJ380751 (RERA record), while Gallant West is registered by M/s Shalimar Corp Ltd. Your agreement should name the same company as the RERA record.
